verdict.rationale: Turso is a database platform, and such a platform could plausibly ship automations (scheduled jobs, triggers, workflows), so the axis applies. The evidence documents no automation feature at all, let alone versioning, review, or rollback of automations. Database branching and point-in-time recovery version and restore data, not automations, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
